The following three-year account prices a broader shared product. Its construction budget tests whether repeated use could justify that larger commitment; it is not the budget requested for the initial matched analyst comparison. That comparison needs its own task count, staffing and cost estimate before funding. Its results would determine whether to retain expert composition, extend the minimal integration or consider the broader construction programme. 101.2 The multi-year investment account and institutional variation A common causal product earns its cost by improving repeated scientific work. The appropriate alternative is a capable quantitative team composing the same open-source methods with ordinary engineering, documentation and review. Such a team can produce good causal studies without a new platform. Charges for unsuccessful studies remain in the cost account. 101.2.5 A staged construction budget and stopping rules For the broader product in this cost account, an illustrative construction tranche assigns six people for six months: one product/economics lead, two causal/econometric scientists, two data/platform engineers and one application engineer. At USD 25,000 per loaded person-month, staff cost is USD 900,000; USD 50,000 compute/tooling and 20% contingency give USD 1.14 million. This tranche is included in the illustrative USD 4 million initial product cost, not added to it. Data-owner, independent validation, security and application-owner participation are unpriced and must be estimated consistently for both alternatives before a bank funds work. The tranche should implement the shared observation/request/evidence objects and qualify a narrow adjusted/cohort and observed-history policy path. Controlled-state fitting and temporal discovery should enter the architecture immediately through finite, explicitly conditional research operations.
